membrane_image.creator: Mike Kayser
membrane_image.caption:
Transmission electron micrograph showing 2 cells.
the upper cell shows part of a nucleus and the
lower one shows smooth endoplasmic reticulum and
secretory granules. This sample has been prepared
as an ultra thin cryo section providing excellent
structural integrity and a softer appearence than
more conventional preparation methods.
limits: Ultra-thin cryosection appearance, not live/natural color
Two adjacent plasma membranes are not the two leaflets of one bilayer
No identified pump/channel/pores or molecular resolution claim
